visualCharacteristics.purpose: cards-review-slider: customer review cards (title, star rating, text, author) in a horizontal slider with prev/next arrows
visualCharacteristics.structure: text cards with a star-rating image, 3 visible on desktop, scroll-snap slider

contentPattern.structure: one row per review: [star-rating image] | [quoted title (bold), review text, author name]. Optional page metadata 'slider-previous' / 'slider-next' sets the arrow button labels (otherwise the target review's title is used)
